title.narrative: Global Quality and Standards Programme Georgia: Strengthening conformity assessment for the fruits and vegetables value chain

description.narrative: In addition to eight full-fledged country projects, the Global Quality and Standards Programme (GQSP) foresees special measures in selected countries. Special measures under the GQSP are measures focused to address specific quality and standards related issues in a given sector, in view of facilitating greater market access. They can relate to enhancing quality infrastructure institutions, strengthening producer#s compliance capacity with market requirements, or the creation of a culture of quality. The special measure in Georgia will focus on conformity assessment and residue testing for the fruits and vegetable sector.
